units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 5:3">Ḥull. V, 3</cite> <he>הנוֹחֵר</he> if one stabs (instead of cutting according to ritual).

<cite ref="Pesachim 49b:4">Pes. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>מותר לנוֹחֲרוֹ</he> you may stab him.—[Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII <he>שלא תנחור</he>, read: <he>תְנַחֵשׁ</he>, v. <cite ref="N00518"><he>נָחַשׁ</he></cite>; Rabad <he>תנקור</he>, v. <cite ref="N01243"><he>נָקַר</he> II</cite>.]
<cite ref="Niddah 64b:27">Nidd. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>כל זמן שנוֹחֶרֶת</he> as long as the healing wound discharges matter. V. <cite ref="N00493"><he>נְחִירָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 17a:6">Ḥull. 17ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>ישחט</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 11:22">Num. XI, 22</cite>) <he>יִנָּחֵר להם מיבעיא ליה</he> (not <cite ref="N00515"><he>ניחר</he></cite>) if no ritual cutting was prescribed for the people in the desert, the text ought to have read, ‘shall be stabbed for them’.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:12">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ס̇נ̇ח̇ר̇יב</he>) <he>שס̇ח̇ ונ̇יח̇ר̇ וכ׳</he> he spoke and snorted forth words against heaven.
